claim_title: Uterine fibroids is associated to heart disease
caption: **Fibroids and heart disease.** One large US study of over 2.7 million commercially insured women found those diagnosed with uterine fibroids were about 2.5x more likely to develop heart disease within a year and 1.8x more likely over 10 years, after balancing groups on age, blood pressure, cholesterol and other factors. The association is large and robust to sensitivity checks, though it can't prove causation — and more frequent doctor visits among women with fibroids may account for some of the extra diagnoses.
subtitle: This is one large, well-adjusted cohort study, but it cannot prove causation.
